summary: Bethia Pringle (1822–1897), eldest child of Benjamin and Charity Pringle of Plymouth, who married Caleb Roberts and moved west to Iowa and Minnesota.
bio: Bethia Pringle was born in Pennsylvania about 21 September 1822, the eldest child of Benjamin Pringle and Charity Gould of Plymouth, Luzerne Co. In 1852 she married Caleb Roberts, and the couple moved to Iowa, where their children Esther, Alfred and Helen were born. She died a widow at Verona, Faribault Co., Minnesota, on 30 December 1897, aged 75 years, 3 months and 9 days; the death register names her parents as Benjamin and Charity Pringle, both born in Pennsylvania.
